description:
**Location:**  
SG, 238891
  
  
**Group:** Sustainability Group
  
**Department:** Sustainability
  
**Section:** Sustainability Strategy
  
**Job Type:** Intern
  
**Req ID:** 12173
  
  
Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore, with a net portfolio value of S$518 billion (US$401b, €350b, £304b, RMB2.77t) as at 31 March 2026. Our Purpose “So Every Generation Prospers” guides us to make a difference for today’s and future generations. We seek to build a resilient and forward-looking portfolio that will deliver good sustainable returns over the long term.
  
  
**We have 13 offices in 9 countries around the world:** Beijing, Hanoi, Mumbai, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore in Asia; and Brussels, London, Mexico City, New York, Paris, San Francisco, and Washington, DC outside Asia.
  
  
For more information on Temasek, please visit www.temasek.com.sg
  
For Temasek Review 2026, please visit www.temasekreview.com.sg
  
For Sustainability Report 2026, please visit www.temasek.com.sg/SR2026
  
  
Introduction
  
  
At Temasek, sustainability is at the core of everything we do – from our mandate to deliver sustainable value over the long term, to our strategy of how we operate as an institution, shape over portfolio, and engage our portfolio companies to build sustainable businesses.
  
  
In partnership with various teams across Temasek and our broader ecosystem, the Sustainability Group initiates, develops and implements strategies to build a climate-resilient, net zero portfolio to enable nature positive and inclusive growth; catalyses new business opportunities and solutions that contribute to sustainable development; advances thought leadership and engagement on sustainability topics; and supports our growth as a sustainable organisation to create shared value aligned with our mandate of generating sustainable returns over the long term.
  
  
The Sustainability Group comprises of the following sub-teams and partners with the investment group and functional teams to strengthen our sustainability capabilities and ecosystem.
  
  
**Sustainability Strategy:** advance our strategy and policy towards net zero, nature positive, and inclusive growth and drive institutional and community-related sustainability initiatives.
  
**Sustainable Solutions:** drive decarbonisation in portfolio companies and unlock new investment opportunities in Sustainable Living trends by identifying emerging thematics and catalysing innovative solutions
  
**ESG Investment Management:** advance ESG integration across our investment process including portfolio engagement to help strengthen long-term portfolio resiliency and value creation
  
**Ecosperity:** accelerate systems-change by harnessing our Ecosperity platform to drive year-round engagements, thought leadership, and advocacy
  
Sustainability Strategy
  
  
Within the Sustainability Group, the Sustainability Strategy team is responsible for setting Temasek’s strategy in driving total impact across the institution, portfolio and ecosystem. This involves:
  
  
Advancing strategy and policy towards net zero, nature positive and inclusive growth;
  
Understanding and keeping abreast with the broader sustainability context, evolving regulatory and market expectations, as well as resulting implications for Temasek as an investor;
  
Partnering internal functional teams to advance our sustainability practices as a firm, and raising awareness of sustainability issues through our staff engagement activities; and
  
Engaging our portfolio companies on top-of-mind sustainability topics to build capacity and resiliency.
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Support horizon scanning, research and analysis of global sustainability policies, regulations, frameworks, and market trends, including assisting in peer benchmarking to identify cross-thematic risks, opportunities, and implications. These will contribute towards materials that inform institutional and portfolio‑level sustainability strategy discussions.
  
Assist in developing and maintaining policy foresight tools such as AI tools and dashboards
  
Support the preparation of executive-ready briefing materials, e.g., slide decks and short notes, to inform strategic reviews and decision-making.
  
Support Temasek’s participation in selected global networks and coalitions through background research, preparation of meeting briefs and note‑taking.
  
Support project leads in internal capability building programmes, integrating policy insights into management training, board insights, and advisory panel programmes.
  
Help curate case studies, examples and reference materials that bring policy insights to life for internal stakeholders.
  
Requirements
  
  
Able to commit full-time for a minimum of 20 weeks. Interns who are able to commit to a full-time (5 days/week) or a minimum of part-time (4 days/week) internship is strongly preferred.
  
Pursuing a degree in Sustainability, Finance, Economics, Public Policy, or a related discipline preferred.
  
Genuine passion for sustainability, environmental and social issues, demonstrated through coursework, internships, projects or volunteer experiences
  
Critical thinking and strong analytical skills
  
Ability to work with sustainability data and metrics
  
Familiarity and comfort with using GenAI tools
  
Good communicator in both written and oral communication, with an eye for detail
  
Adaptability and eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  
Application Requirements
  
  
Interested candidates must submit both a cover letter and resume/CV
  
1-page cover letter should indicate clearly motivation in applying, how past experience applies, as well as candidate’s availability (start and end date)
  
Resume/CV submitted may be no longer than 2 pages. 1 page is preferred.
  
Where required, candidates will be given a short case study to complete as part of the application process.

title: Senior Executive, Sustainability Development
description:
**Job Overview:**

The **Senior Executive, Sustainability Development** is responsible for driving business growth and market expansion of Bureau Veritas' sustainability services across the organization. The role is responsible for identifying and developing business opportunities, strengthening client and partner relationships, supporting sales conversion, and enabling cross-selling of sustainability solutions across BV business lines.

Working closely with clients, ecosystem partners and internal teams, the Senior Executive will help translate market trends, client needs, and regulatory requirements into fit-for-purpose sustainability offerings. The role will also support go-to-market initiatives, proposal development, pipeline management, and internal sales enablement to contribute to the growth of BV Regional Institute of Sustainability and Energy Transition (RISE) and sustainability-related services.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Build and develop sales pipeline through external and internal engagements**

* Identify and prospect for new clients through networking, referrals, industry events, market research and social media channels to build pipeline of new leads and opportunities.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of leads and opportunities across sustainability reporting, ESG assurance, GHG verification, carbon management, sustainable finance, climate-related services, training, and advisory solutions
* Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, strategic partners, industry associations, ecosystem players, and internal stakeholders to drive business development.
* Collaborate with BV teams across business lines to promote sustainability-related cross-selling and integrated service offerings.
* Conduct market research and monitor sustainability trends, regulations, reporting requirements, and competitor activities to identify new service opportunities and needs.

**Lead sales process to present sustainability services, advise and scope projects with clients to develop sustainability solutions that meet their needs, manage sales process and follow-ups with clients to secure contracts, resolve any issues or complaints.**

* Prepare sales proposals, tender responses, presentations, and commercial documents for internal review and approval by the RISE Manager / Sustainability Development Lead.
* Engage clients to understand their business objectives, sustainability priorities, drivers and service requirements.
* Work closely with internal technical teams to develop sustainability solutions.
* Develop sustainability sales tools, service brochures, client presentations, proposals, and other business development enablers
* Coordinate with technical teams, legal, finance, subcontractors and internal stakeholders on contract preparation, NDA / MOU drafting, project requirements, and commercial documentation.
* Ensure timely follow-up with clients on proposals, quotations, pending decisions, and outstanding information to improve sales conversion.
* Negotiate, renew and secure contracts with clients and subcontractors to achieve team targets.
* Work with RISE Manager / Sustainability Development Lead to co-develop signature projects and business development strategy based on market trends, support engagements with Key Accounts.

**Internal coordination and commercial support**

* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth handover, mobilisation and successful delivery of sustainability projects.
* Coordinate with Finance to facilitate timely invoicing and payments
* Maintain accurate records of pipeline status, proposals, contracts, and client engagements.
* Maintain accurate and updated records on CRM systems to support sales reporting, pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and performance monitoring
* Support cross-border collaborations in project delivery and in the development of go-to-market initiatives for sustainability services

**Key Deliverables:**

* Set up regular engagement sessions with clients and strategic partners to identify new leads, market needs and business opportunities.
* Build and maintain an active sustainability business development pipeline, with timely updates on opportunities, proposal status, contract progress, and client follow-ups, maintain accountability over business targets
* Collaborations with BV SEA teams to optimize resource sharing, capacity building, role-crossing on projects for bigger wins.
* Develop Sales Kits and proposals on sustainability services, including Climate and decarbonization-related services, GHG verification, Sustainability reporting and assurance, Supply Chain Sustainability, ISCC, Sustainable Financing-related services, Sustainability Training programs.

**Job Requirements:**

* 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in business development, sales, account management, sustainability consulting, ESG verification or related fields, preferably in a sales or business development role
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sustainability, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related discipline
* Good understanding of sustainability frameworks and reporting standards (GRI, SASB, TCFD, IFRS, GHG Protocol, Ecovadis, LCA), and regulatory requirements
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage clients, partners, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams across different organizational levels
